title: Squaring-the-Sphere: Distortion-Free and Seamless Panorama Generation via CubeAtlas
abstract: Generating 360-degree panoramas requires both local perspective fidelity and global spherical continuity. Existing representations face a trade-off: equirectangular projection (ERP) enables seamless panorama modeling but suffers from severe distortion and a domain gap to pre-trained image generators, whereas cubemaps preserve perspective geometry but often produce inconsistent faces and visible seams. We present Squaring-the-Sphere, a panoramic image generation framework built on a novel representation CubeAtlas, which unfolds all cubemap faces into a single compact canvas. By arranging orientation-aligned, rotated polar regions alongside the equatorial faces, this representation preserves the perspective geometry of cubemaps while organizing the cross-face relationships required for seamless panorama assembly. It further enables a pretrained diffusion transformer to model the complete panorama jointly in a single pass, without altering the backbone architecture or positional encoding. While CubeAtlas has a token count comparable to ERP, its structured layout makes many dense attention interactions unnecessary. We therefore introduce a layout-aware sparse attention mask that preserves the interactions required for panorama continuity while removing geometrically irrelevant token pairs. As a result, CubeAtlas achieves better quality than ERP modeling with lower attention computation. Furthermore, we introduce a training-free super-resolution technique and a fusion scheme that enhance fine details in distortion-free perspective space before achieving the final ERP panorama. Experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves geometric fidelity, cross-view consistency, and high-resolution visual quality over previous methods.

summary.title_zh: 化球为方：基于CubeAtlas的无畸变无缝全景图生成
summary.core_contribution: 提出了一种名为CubeAtlas的全新全景图表示方法，将立方体贴图的六个面展开为单一紧凑画布，在保持透视几何的同时实现无缝全景生成，并引入布局感知的稀疏注意力机制以降低计算成本。
summary.method: CubeAtlas将立方体贴图的赤道面与经过旋转对齐的极区面排列在同一画布上，保留跨面关系以支持无缝拼接。基于此表示，预训练扩散Transformer可在单次前向中联合建模完整全景图，无需修改骨干架构或位置编码。针对CubeAtlas的结构化布局，设计了布局感知的稀疏注意力掩码，移除几何无关的token对，保留全景连续性所需的交互。此外，引入免训练超分辨率技术和融合方案，在无畸变透视空间中增强细节后再生成最终ERP全景图。
summary.findings: 实验表明，该方法在几何保真度、跨视角一致性和高分辨率视觉质量上优于先前方法；CubeAtlas在token数量与ERP相当的情况下，以更低的注意力计算量实现了优于ERP建模的质量。

title: HimmBO: High-Dimensional Interactive Model-Merging Bayesian Optimization for Image Generation
abstract: Fine-tuning has become a common way to customize text-to-image models, leading to community collections of over 100K lightweight adapters. Adapters sharing a base model can be merged with continuous coefficients. This turns a large collection into a high-dimensional continuous design space, which recent work explores interactively using preferential Bayesian optimization (PBO). However, existing approaches are limited to a few dozen preselected adapters and require expensive image generation in every interaction round. We introduce HimmBO, a two-stage method that scales preference-driven adapter merging to much larger collections while reducing image-generation cost. Its screening stage recovers the active adapter set through level-set estimation over pre-generated images, requiring no image generation. The refinement stage then optimizes merge coefficients in the recovered low-dimensional subspace. Both stages use a style-aware kernel, allowing preference information to transfer between visually similar adapters. In simulated-user image-matching experiments, HimmBO achieves higher final similarity than all comparisons while reaching a given similarity with under one tenth of the image generations required by prior work. Its performance remains stable as the collection grows to 1080 adapters, while competing methods degrade substantially.

summary.title_zh: HimmBO：面向图像生成的高维交互式模型合并贝叶斯优化
summary.core_contribution: 提出一种两阶段方法HimmBO，将偏好驱动的适配器合并扩展到更大规模的适配器集合，同时大幅降低图像生成成本。
summary.method: 该方法分为筛选阶段和精炼阶段。筛选阶段通过对预生成图像进行水平集估计来恢复活跃适配器集合，无需生成新图像；精炼阶段在恢复的低维子空间中优化合并系数。两个阶段均使用风格感知核，使偏好信息能在视觉相似的适配器之间迁移。
summary.findings: 在模拟用户图像匹配实验中，HimmBO的最终相似度高于所有对比方法，且达到给定相似度所需的图像生成次数不到先前方法的十分之一。当适配器集合增长到1080个时，其性能保持稳定，而竞争方法则显著退化。

title: BrickWright: Agentic Creation of Physically Feasible Brick Builds
abstract: Frontier coding agents are becoming increasingly adept at 3D modeling. Yet, they still face challenges when building objects meant to be assembled in the physical world, often creating invalid assemblies with floating, colliding, or disconnected parts. We argue that providing agents with tools for assembling builds and verifying their physical feasibility is sufficient for them to produce physically valid assemblies that still adhere to input prompts. Focusing on the domain of LEGO brick builds, we present BrickWright, a framework for generating physically feasible brick builds from text or image prompts using pre-trained agents, where a build is physically feasible if it uses only real parts, has no colliding or floating parts, and forms a connected structure if possible. BrickWright guides agents to create builds by writing code with BrickLayer, a Python toolkit with two main components: an ergonomic brick assembly API that halves inference cost compared to working in raw LDraw, and a validator that provides feedback on physical feasibility. Whereas baseline agents achieve physical validity rates ranging from only 9% (GPT-6 Luna) to 69% (GPT-6 Astra), BrickWright-guided agents achieve 100% validity on a sample of 512 prompts, while improving prompt adherence for lightweight agents and maintaining it for stronger agents. Additionally, they outperform specialized models on the text-to-brick task. Code is available on our project page: https://avalovelace1.github.io/brickwright/

summary.title_zh: BrickWright：智能体驱动的物理可行乐高积木构建生成
summary.core_contribution: 提出BrickWright框架，通过为预训练编码智能体提供积木组装工具和物理可行性验证器，使其能够根据文本或图像提示生成物理上可行的乐高积木构建，在512个提示样本上实现100%的物理有效性。
summary.method: BrickWright引导智能体使用BrickLayer（一个Python工具包）编写代码来创建构建。BrickLayer包含两个主要组件：一个符合人体工程学的积木组装API（相比直接使用原始LDraw格式将推理成本减半）和一个提供物理可行性反馈的验证器。物理可行性定义为仅使用真实零件、无碰撞或悬浮零件、并尽可能形成连通结构。
summary.findings: 基线智能体的物理有效性率仅为9%（GPT-6 Luna）到69%（GPT-6 Astra），而BrickWright引导的智能体在512个提示样本上达到100%有效性，同时提升了轻量级智能体的提示遵循度并保持了强智能体的提示遵循度。此外，在文本到积木任务上，该方法优于专用模型。

title: One Evaluation Is Enough: Inversion-Free Image Editing with Trajectory Correction
abstract: Real-image editing commonly relies on inversion and iterative sampling, while efficient one-step editors often stabilize a large update by estimating and averaging editing fields at multiple noise levels. We ask a stricter question: is a single temporal field evaluation sufficient for reliable inversion-free editing? Our answer rests on a previously underused duality in a variance-preserving (VP) one-step model: one source-target query at a shared noisy state simultaneously determines a local angular semantic tangent and a clean endpoint displacement. We integrate the tangent over the analytically known remaining VP angle to obtain a nominal one-step transport, and use the endpoint displacement to correct its long-horizon extrapolation through a constrained projection. This transport-first, correction-second construction yields Endpoint-Calibrated Transport (ECT), a closed-form, training-free editor requiring only one noise level, two text conditions packed into one denoiser batch, and one latent update. ECT requires no image inversion, trajectory integration, second temporal observation, or iterative optimization, and can be directly applied to pretrained epsilon-prediction VP one-step generators. Across the reported benchmark settings, ECT delivers stable gains in editing quality within an extremely short editing time.

summary.title_zh: 一次评估足矣：基于轨迹校正的无反演图像编辑
summary.core_contribution: 论文提出端点校准传输（ECT），一种无需训练、闭式的图像编辑器，仅需单次时间场评估即可实现可靠的无反演编辑，避免了图像反演、轨迹积分和迭代优化。
summary.method: 利用方差保持（VP）一步模型中源-目标查询在共享噪声状态下的对偶性，同时确定局部角度语义切线和干净端点位移。将切线沿解析已知的剩余VP角度积分得到名义一步传输，并用端点位移通过约束投影校正其长程外推。该“先传输后校正”的构造形成闭式、免训练的编辑器，仅需一个噪声水平、两个文本条件打包进一个去噪器批次和一次潜在更新。
summary.findings: 在报告的基准设置中，ECT在极短的编辑时间内稳定提升了编辑质量，且无需图像反演、轨迹积分、第二次时间观测或迭代优化，可直接应用于预训练的epsilon预测VP一步生成器。

title: ParaLin++: Accelerating Parallel Diffusion Integrator via Intrinsic Partially Linear Structure
abstract: Training-free few-step samplers are often described as nearly quality-lossless under conventional FID/CLIP-style evaluation. It remains unclear whether that conclusion transfers to more realistic and complex generation-quality benchmarks. We first systematize the quality metrics used to evaluate training-free sampling acceleration for diffusion and flow-matching models. We find that representative training-free step-shortening methods often remain nearly lossless under FID/CLIP-class metrics, yet can suffer substantial quality degradation when evaluated with semantic-composition, dense-instruction, and long-text-rendering benchmarks such as GenEval, DPG-Bench, and LongTextBench. Parallel sampling is a notable exception: by retaining the full-step discretization and removing only the solver's temporal dependency, it can preserve near-lossless quality while accelerating sampling. Building on this observation, we propose \textit{ParaLin++}, a step-parity parallel sampler that preserves the full-step discretization while accelerating the solver iterations. Experiments across Stable Diffusion-v2, LSUN Church, FLUX.1-dev, and Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0 show that ParaLin++ preserves the full-step Euler quality profile at $2.6\times$--$4.8\times$, $1.68\times$ on FLUX, and $1.21\times$ on Ming. Project page: https://paralinplus.github.io/.

summary.title_zh: ParaLin++：通过内在部分线性结构加速并行扩散积分器
summary.core_contribution: 论文系统性地揭示了现有免训练少步采样器在FID/CLIP类指标下看似无损、但在语义组合和长文本渲染等复杂基准上存在显著质量退化的问题，并提出ParaLin++——一种保持全步离散化、仅去除求解器时间依赖性的步数对齐并行采样器，在保持全步Euler质量的同时实现显著加速。
summary.method: 作者首先系统化梳理了用于评估扩散与流匹配模型免训练采样加速的质量指标，并在GenEval、DPG-Bench、LongTextBench等复杂基准上对比了代表性少步采样方法。基于并行采样能保留全步离散化、仅消除求解器时间依赖从而保持近无损质量的观察，提出ParaLin++并行采样器，在保持全步Euler质量剖面的前提下加速求解器迭代。
summary.findings: 实验表明，代表性免训练步数缩短方法在FID/CLIP类指标下近乎无损，但在语义组合、密集指令和长文本渲染基准上质量明显下降；并行采样是显著例外。ParaLin++在Stable Diffusion-v2、LSUN Church上实现2.6倍至4.8倍加速，在FLUX.1-dev上实现1.68倍加速，在Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0上实现1.21倍加速，同时保持全步Euler的质量剖面。
